title: Radicle
summary: RAD'ICLE, noun [Latin radicula, from radix.] 1. That part of the seed of a plant which upon vegetating becomes the root. 2. The fibrous part of a root, by which the stock or main body of it is termina

inlines.v: RAD'ICLE, noun [Latin radicula, from radix.] 1. That part of the seed of a plant which upon vegetating becomes the root. 2. The fibrous part of a root, by which the stock or main body of it is terminated.
